## Professional Experience

### FullStack Labs

Contracted to a US construction-technology platform. Remote, Colombia.

- Senior Software Engineer (April 2024–Present)
- Mid-Level Software Engineer (January 2022–April 2024)

Worked on onboarding services through mid-2025, then on company and project home surfaces.

1. Shipped an in-app toggle between a legacy portfolio experience and company/project home across a Ruby on Rails monolith and React UI. Implemented the admin API and authorization, shared eligibility and redirects, configuration defaults, and a confirmation step before bulk project-home updates.
2. Built company and project home UI in React 18, TypeScript, and Next.js; delivered default project routing, project-information and open-items cards, and the project team panel. Configured feature-flag beta segments for production and sandbox.
3. Moved company-home views to a service API using Node.js/NestJS and AWS DynamoDB Streams. Seeded default company, project, and development containers and emitted outbox events through Kafka Connect to Databricks; removed legacy cutover flags after rollout.
4. Improved keyboard access and screen-reader behavior across portfolio, safety, and project-home screens, including tab navigation and roles, keyboard use of notes actions, and weather announcements.

### DataHome, S. de R.L. de C.V.

DataHome provided software and infrastructure for a trip service used by drivers, passengers, and transport companies, earning a small fee per trip.

- Senior Software Engineer (March 2019–December 2021)
- Junior Software Developer (January 2017–March 2019)
- Developer Intern (June 2016–December 2016)
- Built the Android app for drivers and passengers, first in Java and later in Kotlin; developed the trip-platform dashboard with Vue.js and PostgreSQL.
- Reorganized PHP web-service logic from one large file into a multi-file Zend Framework backend; made technical decisions on a four-person team.
